Usage:

```bash
python3 -m astrid executors run builtin.search_loras \
  --input base_model=stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 \
  --out runs/search-loras
```

Direct run supports extra options like `--query`, `--limit`, and `--sort`.
